verdict.rationale: GitBook does not document exporting a site as a hostable static bundle; it is presented as a hosted SaaS with custom domains. Its GitHub/GitLab Sync keeps content as Markdown in your own repo, which addresses lock-in, but self-hosting would require a separate static-site generator. Community reports say the platform moved to SaaS-only and the old open-source CLI that rendered HTML is no longer actively developed. Missing for 10: a documented static-site export/build, self-hostable output, and hands-on evidence of hosting GitBook output elsewhere.
